wallpapers.title: A face you don't forget
wallpapers.caption: Male bearded reedling, Norfolk, England
wallpapers.desc: Balanced on a slender stalk in Norfolk, England, the male bearded reedling in today's image stands out with a pale blue-gray head, a bright orange bill, and the black facial markings that give the species its name. Despite its striking appearance, this small bird spends much of its life hidden among the dense wetland vegetation of marshes, lakeshores, and reed beds.
